facts.fact: 他的判读：她跑是因为想被追，她屈服是因为想被抓。
facts.anchor: She'd run because she wanted me to chase her.

facts.fact: 他的课题：放倒她与照顾她之间的区别。
facts.anchor: I had to show her I knew the difference between taking her down and taking care of her.

facts.fact: 底线：她喜欢被压倒但不喜欢被撕开——他绝不再弄坏她。
facts.anchor: I wasn't going to break her again.

facts.fact: 他对爱的猜测：像坠落，明该怕落地，却毫不在乎。
facts.anchor: Like falling when there was nothing beneath you

facts.fact: 他的自我定义：不做弄坏她的莽汉，要做把她兜住的人。
facts.anchor: I wanted to be the man who held her together.

facts.fact: 她的反向反应：疼的时候她不是躲开，是往他怀里钻。
facts.anchor: I was the place she went to when something hurt.

facts.fact: 反转：他以为自己是猎手，其实被认领了。
全书他的第一次告白（独白）。
facts.anchor: I was in love with Rosalind Blackwood.
